result.text:
I had no idea where they started. If somebody came from a really bad place, meditation could change their life and they could still be a mess in a relationship. I’d learn more from the last real conflict than from the biggest spiritual experience they ever had.
Someone can sound very self-aware talking about old problems too. Then I notice every problem is safely over and every ex was the problem. Okay, what are you still doing now? What am I going to find out later?
